purpose: Deterministic controlled sample pipeline configuration for P5-B1. This uses synthetic fixtures only and does not download, scrape, parse CityGML, perform GIS routing, or perform real PLATEAU matching.

statusMappingRules.description: Official evidence plus a contains match can produce official_confirmed when no manual review warning applies.
Official evidence plus a nearest match produces official_confirmed_with_review and requires manual review.
Non-official evidence with controlled candidate threshold coverage can produce strong_candidate, never official_confirmed.
Candidate evidence with missing safeFloor or capacity produces weak_candidate and warnings.
Records without enough evidence produce unknown.
Controlled conflict or canEnter=false produces not_qualified with review warnings.
Unmatched shelter/building records produce unknown or not_qualified, not official_confirmed.

warningRules.nearestDistanceTooLarge: nearest match distance exceeds high-confidence threshold
warningRules.literatureCannotConfirmOfficial: literature criteria cannot confirm official designation
warningRules.notQualified: not qualified based on controlled conflict evidence
warningRules.routePrototype: route is a controlled prototype estimate, not an official evacuation route
